verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI's own docs and README describe batch processing of many URLs: multi-URL configuration applies different strategies to different URL patterns in one batch, and parallel crawling plus multi-page deep crawl cover bulk operation across many items. The evidence is brief, one-line feature claims rather than detailed batch API documentation. Missing for 10: detailed docs for the batch/many-URL API (concurrency limits, per-item error handling), independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Multi-URL Configuration: Different strategies for different URL patterns in one batch
